removeConfirm: Remove this registration? The target Agent will not be deleted.

reasons.destination_unreachable: Destination unreachable. Check DNS, network and TLS.

reasons.remote_auth_rejected: Authentication rejected. Check credentials and permissions.

reasons.card_endpoint_origin_mismatch: Agent Card endpoint must share the configured origin.

reasons.credential_reflected_in_card: Agent Card reflected a credential and was rejected.
reasons.credential_store_unavailable: Credential storage unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the database and encryption key.

missing: This registration was removed. Refresh the list.
uncertain: Operation outcome is uncertain. Refresh to reconcile before making another change.
savedSecretHelp: A credential is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it.
enabledHelp: Allow this MPA to dispatch tasks to this Agent; disabling retains configuration.

center.title: A2A Center
center.help: This MPA can call running agents in the selected space, including future additions. Resources belong to the target Runtime account and region.
center.disconnectConfirm: Stop new dispatches from this MPA to the space? No space or agent will be deleted.
center.noSpaces: No accessible A2A spaces in this account and region.
center.failed: Cannot load A2A Center. Check Runtime AgentKit query permissions and network, then retry.
center.forbidden: Access denied. Check Studio management and Runtime query permissions.
center.refreshRequired: Save outcome is unconfirmed or configuration changed. Refresh before retrying.

registration.runtimeListFailed: Unable to load the Runtime list. Check access permissions and retry.
registration.invalidCard: Enter a JSON object containing name, url and version.
registration.invalid: Check the source, selected Runtime and Agent Card. Card input must be within 128 KB.
registration.failed: Registration rejected. Check access to the space and source.
registration.uncertain: Registration outcome is unknown. Close this form and refresh the center to check before creating another Agent.
registration.runtimeExists: This Runtime is already registered in A2A Center. Check its existing space; deregister the existing record before registering in another space.
registration.endpointsFailed: Unable to read Runtime access endpoints. Check access permissions and try again.
registration.noEndpoints: This Runtime has no available public or private address.
registration.endpointRequired: Select a Runtime and load an available access endpoint first.
registration.noRuntimes: No Runtimes are available to select in this region.

spaceCreation.name: Space name
spaceCreation.intentHelp: Find matching Agents in this space from the calling intent.
spaceCreation.invalid: Enter valid space and project names, each up to 128 characters.
spaceCreation.failed: Could not create the space. Check the account, region and create permission, then retry.
spaceCreation.uncertain: Space creation is unconfirmed. Refresh and check the space list before creating another space.
spaceCreation.forbidden: Space creation is not authorized. Check Studio management access, Runtime access and AgentKit space creation permission.

member.unregisterHelp: All callers will lose discovery and invocation of this Agent through this space. Its source Runtime and service will remain.
member.loadFailed: Could not load Agent details. Check access and connectivity, then retry.
member.skillsUnavailable: AgentCard skill information is currently unavailable.

spaceDeletion.help: Space deletion cannot be undone. Other callers will lose access through this space. Confirm that dependent applications no longer use it.
spaceDeletion.bound: Disconnect this MPA from the space first.
spaceDeletion.nonempty: Deregister all Agents in the space first.

actions.uncertain: The outcome is unconfirmed. Close the dialog and refresh the Center before another attempt.
actions.forbidden: This action is not authorized. Check Studio management and AgentKit action permissions.
actions.rejected: The action was rejected. Refresh and check the resource state before retrying.
actions.preflightFailed: Preflight checks failed; deregistration or deletion has not run. Check connectivity and retry.
actions.runtimeAuthFailed: Runtime authentication failed before deletion. Nothing was deleted. Refresh the Runtime connection and try again.

alias.label: Agent alias
alias.help: Names this Agent within this space for the current MPA. Leave empty to clear. Use @helper followed by a task, or @"Code Assistant" for a name with spaces.
alias.unavailable: This Runtime does not support Agent aliases. Upgrade the Runtime and refresh.
alias.invalid: Use up to 80 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens.
alias.conflict: Another Agent in this space uses this alias. Choose a different name.
alias.revisionConflict: Someone changed this alias. Refresh before trying again.
alias.failed: The save result is uncertain. Refresh the list before trying again.
